model.name: The client transmits owner identity on every owner-gated action (owner controls are browser-unusable until it does)
model.description: HEADLINE: every owner-gated UI control - Set-as-Current, Approve, Decline, designate - is STRUCTURALLY UNUSABLE from the browser FOR EVERYONE, not just Tron. NAMED FAILING STEP: the CLIENT NEVER TRANSMITS OWNER IDENTITY. Measured (architect, two EMPTY greps as evidence): (1) no client code ever POSTs /api/server-manager/session - no UI surface mints an owner cookie; (2) no client fetch ever sends x-player-token - make-current/approve/decline/designate send credentials same-origin with NO identity header. So resolveOwner's cookie branch is never minted and its protected-identity branch never receives a token; the browser can only pass via the OWNER_TOKEN literal, which no real user carries. R40.45 readied the SERVER to recognise owner 05e58f81; the CLIENT was never wired to SEND it. This is the 403 half of Tron's failed Set-as-Current (distinct from and bigger than the CR-band 409/status half).
model.namedFailingStep: THE CLIENT NEVER TRANSMITS OWNER IDENTITY

measuredSurface.server_no_change: ServerManagerGuard.playerTokenFrom(req) reads req.headers[x-player-token] only; resolveOwner + R40.45 branch-3 map it to the owner profile -> 200. Server ALREADY accepts x-player-token; no server change needed.
measuredSurface.bug_sites: src/public/ts/trace/universal-actions.ts - make-current :138, designate :171, approve/decline (handleTaskVerdict ~:99) all fetch with credentials:same-origin and NO identity header.
measuredSurface.token_source: RawBinClient.playerToken (live authenticated token the client already holds; used by RoomBrowser/rb-avatar/viewBus) - NOT a scratch-minted cookie.
measuredSurface.precedent: server.ts:1130 (SM page shell) already fetches /api/server-manager/session with headers x-player-token:token; the send-pattern is proven, just never applied to the owner-action buttons.

discoverySource.evidence: two empty greps: no client POSTs /api/server-manager/session (no owner cookie minted); no client fetch sends x-player-token (owner actions same-origin, no identity header). The live 403 on make-current is this session-recognition gap, NOT per-task ownerIor (R40.49 correctly owns the tasks but does not resolve the permission error).

model.crossRefNote: R40.45 made the SERVER recognise the owner (branch-3 / 05e58f81); R40.52 wires the CLIENT to SEND the identity. Server-ready-client-unwired gap. Pairs with the CR-band (409/status) as the OTHER half of Tron Set-as-Current; keep separate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ONE SHARED, DEDICATED ownerActionFetch(url,opts) helper (owner-actions-ONLY, NOT a blanket fetch wrapper - the owner identity header is attached ONLY to owner actions, never leaked onto non-owner requests) merges headers[x-player-token] = RawBinClient.playerToken, and ALL 4 owner actions route through it - the 4 raw same-origin fetches in universal-actions.ts (make-current :138, designate :171, approve/decline ~:99) are REPLACED. NOT per-button: a per-call-site patch regresses the moment someone adds a button, so identity is attached at ONE shared choke point. Uses the token the client already holds (RawBinClient.playerToken), not a scratch-minted cookie.

Reuses the EXISTING R40.45 server recognition path (ServerManagerGuard.playerTokenFrom -> resolveOwner branch-3 -> owner 05e58f81); server ALREADY accepts x-player-token so NO server change; the send-pattern is the proven precedent at server.ts:1130 (SM page shell). NO new trust surface, no new endpoint, no second identity mechanism.

Acceptance MUST traverse the REAL USER PATH: a real page @390 headed/xvfb WebKit, NO manual/harness-minted cookie, an owner action returns 200 driven by the client own RawBinClient.playerToken - AND a non-owner token still 403s (fail-closed intact). Construction / local-emit / harness-session proofs are INADMISSIBLE.
A manual-cookie or harness-minted-session workaround is EXPLICITLY REJECTED as a solution - it proves the endpoint, not the feature. The UI itself must transmit the identity.

A harness-granted capability the PRODUCT lacks scopes any green to the ENDPOINT, never the FEATURE. The tester earlier got true-but-useless 200s because the harness minted a session NO UI can mint; a Test whose precondition is a harness-only capability must be certified as ENDPOINT-proven, FEATURE-unproven (stub-must-fail: a FEATURE-green claimed on a harness-minted session => RED).
